children: Lennar is lowering its fiscal 2026 delivery target to 80,000 to 81,000 homes, down from the 82,000 to 83,000 homes discussed last quarter, the company said. The reduction reflects continued pressure from elevated mortgage rates, which rose to approximately 6.8% at quarter end and have climbed higher since. Executive Chairman Stuart Miller attributed the move to deteriorating market conditions, citing persistent inflation, geopolitical tension and declining consumer confidence. For the fourth quarter, Lennar expects deliveries of 22,000 to 23,000 homes with gross margin of 15.5% to 16%.
